name: The majority voted in favour of an [amendment](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/divisions/senate/2018-06-25/12) moved by South Australian Senator [Anne Ruston](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/sa/anne_ruston) (Liberal), which adds the words below to the usual [second reading motion](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/divisions/senate/2018-06-25/12). ### Amendment text > *At the end of the motion, add:* > > *"and for the purposes of subsection 48(2) of the Legislation Act 2003, the Senate approves the making of an instrument the same in substance as the [Basin Plan Amendment Instrument 2017 (No. 1)](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/divisions/senate/2018-02-14/11), which was disallowed by the Senate on 14 February 2018".*
